* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Persistence to see projects through to completion

 You'll work within one of our product verticals (Custody, On/Off Ramps, Issuance, or Shared Services), collaborating closely with product managers, compliance, and other engineers. Our teams are small and cross\-functional, which means your work ships fast and has direct impact on customers and partners.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to build financial infrastructure at a 30\+ person company where ownership is real. We expect engineers to take initiative. Whether that's shipping features, improving observability, or strengthening the codebase. If you want to work on hard problems in a regulated domain where your contributions matter immediately, we'd love to talk.
   

  

****Work to Be Done****

 We are a startup, so the pace is fast and the specific work will change. You need to be okay with that.
   

  

 If you think this is something you can handle, we will be excited to speak with you.

This role is primarily focused on frontend/UI development: designing, implementing, testing, and improving customer\-facing web applications that help users complete complex workflows with confidence.
   

  

 You will develop software with simplification, accessibility, secure coding, user privacy, and user experience at the core of your work. You will partner closely with design, product management, backend engineering, QA, and other teams to translate customer and business needs into clean, responsive, accessible, and maintainable web experiences.
   

  

 You will create technical design documentation for the engineering team and contribute to user\-facing documentation where needed. You will debug and address software issues during development and in production systems, bring new ideas for product innovation, and help improve frontend engineering practices across the team.
   

  

 You will be encouraged to use AI\-assisted development tools responsibly to improve your development workflow, accelerate learning, generate and refine code, strengthen tests, improve documentation, and increase day\-to\-day engineering productivity while maintaining accountability for code quality, security, and correctness.

* Build and improve frontend features for customer\-facing web applications, with emphasis on usability, responsiveness, accessibility, performance, secure coding, and maintainable code.
* Develop software that prioritizes simplification, accessibility, and a user\-centered approach.
* Translate product requirements, UX designs, and technical constraints into clean, functional UI implementations.
* Design and implement reusable frontend components using modern JavaScript or TypeScript patterns and frontend frameworks or libraries.
* Partner with designers and product managers to clarify user needs, iterate on prototypes, validate interaction patterns, and deliver intuitive interfaces that solve real customer problems.
* Collaborate with backend/API engineers to integrate UI features with services, data models, and platform capabilities.
* Contribute to straightforward business and customer problems involving product workflows, operations, services, or customer experience.
* Analyze information, ask questions, and check for understanding using standard procedures within the job family.
* Establish relationships and collaborate effectively with your immediate team and cross\-functional partners.
* Work on small\-to\-medium frontend features from technical design through completion.
* Apply understanding of the software development lifecycle and agile engineering practices, including requirements analysis, design, coding, unit testing, acceptance testing, and iterative delivery.
* Participate in delivery of technical designs and frontend implementation plans with guidance.
* Write clean, functional, testable code and unit/component tests with guidance.
* Debug, test, and troubleshoot UI behavior across supported browsers, environments, and user workflows.
* Assist in code reviews and address code review feedback.
* Execute tests for reliability, performance, accessibility, scale, and velocity within your own code.
* Apply secure coding principles, protect user privacy, and help review code for compliance with security expectations.
* Monitor and triage UI\-related incident reports, participate in postmortems, and support production issues as needed.
* Develop expertise in one area of the frontend codebase, design system, or product workflow.
* Share knowledge from independent learning and emerging frontend best practices with the team.
* Use AI\-assisted development tools responsibly to improve coding, testing, debugging, documentation, and learning workflows while validating generated output for quality, security, and maintainability.

**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Software Engineer II
   

  

**Overview**
 Mastercard’s Portfolio Intelligence team, part of the Services organization, is seeking a Software Engineer II to help build high\-performance analytics platform that enable businesses around the world to unlock greater value from their data.
   

  

 In this role, you will leverage your full\-stack development expertise to design, build, deploy, and scale real\-time, interactive applications used by thousands of clients globally. These applications empower users to benchmark portfolio performance, monitor key performance indicators, and generate actionable dashboards and reports using Mastercard’s rich data assets.
   

  

 Our next generation platform blends industry\-leading analytics, advanced software architecture, and the latest web technologies. You will play a vital role within a rapidly growing organization, while working closely with experienced and driven engineers to solve challenging problems.
   

  

 Engineers work in small, flexible teams. Every team member contributes to designing, building, and testing features. We take an agile approach to software development and practice continuous integration and delivery. The range of work that a team will encounter varies from front\-end web development to writing server\-side calculation code to database work. We prefer no rigid organizational structures; each team uses processes that work the best for its members and projects. You will be working closely with our US teams based in Arlington, VA and New York City, NY, as well as teams based in Pune, India.
   

  

 This is a hybrid position based in Arlington, VA, requiring three days per week onsite.
   

  

**Role**
* Design and develop scalable, service\-oriented software architectures supporting analytics\-driven applications.
* Drive the development of robust web applications and continuously enhance product capabilities.
* Produce well\-structured, maintainable code using modern design patterns and principles that ensure separation of concerns.
